title: Risk management system
condition: Only where the system is classified as high-risk under the Act; classification must be established from intended purpose and Annex III / product-safety route.
requirement: Establish, implement, document and maintain a continuous risk-management system across the high-risk AI system lifecycle.
evidence: AI system inventory and intended-purpose statement

title: Human oversight
condition: Applies to high-risk AI systems. The nature of oversight depends on system design, intended purpose and risk.
requirement: Design the system so natural persons can effectively oversee it, understand limitations, monitor anomalies, disregard or reverse outputs, and stop the system where appropriate.

title: Deployer obligations
condition: Only where deploying a high-risk AI system; confirm applicable dates, role allocation and exceptions in the consolidated text.
requirement: Use the system in accordance with instructions, assign competent human oversight, monitor operation, retain logs under applicable conditions and inform relevant parties of serious risks or incidents.

title: Protection and prevention
condition: For financial entities within DORA scope; assess entity category and ICT service arrangements. Third-party providers are addressed through separate DORA provisions and oversight regimes.
requirement: Maintain appropriate ICT security policies, procedures, protocols and tools to protect systems and data, including resilience, availability, authenticity, integrity and confidentiality.

title: ICT-related incident management
condition: For financial entities within DORA scope; classification and reporting thresholds are governed by DORA and related technical standards.
requirement: Establish and implement an ICT-related incident management process to detect, manage and notify ICT-related incidents.

title: Algorithmic trading systems and controls
condition: Where an investment firm engages in algorithmic trading. Determine whether the agent's functionality meets the legal definition of algorithmic trading and consider national competent-authority requirements.
requirement: Maintain resilient trading systems, trading thresholds and limits, controls against erroneous orders and disorderly markets, business continuity, testing, monitoring and required records.

basis: FCA Handbook · SYSC (relevant provisions; verify firm category and current rule text)
title: Systems, controls and governance
condition: Depends on FCA/PRA perimeter, permissions, firm category and the specific SYSC provisions in force.
requirement: Maintain governance, systems and controls proportionate to the firm's regulated activities, including oversight of outsourced and technology-enabled processes where applicable.

basis: MAS Guidelines on AI Risk Management for Financial Institutions (7 October 2026)
title: Financial-institution AI risk management expectations
condition: MAS states the guidelines apply to all financial institutions and all forms of AI; effective 7 October 2027. Confirm institution type and exact guideline text.
requirement: Establish risk governance and lifecycle controls proportionate to AI use, including oversight, data, performance, cybersecurity and third-party dependencies.

basis: FSB Sound Practices for Responsible Adoption of AI · 15 October 2026
title: Responsible AI sound practices for financial institutions
condition: Non-binding international sound practices. The FSB encourages boards and senior management to reference them; they are not directly enforceable law by themselves.
requirement: Consider 12 sound practices covering strategy and oversight, governance, risk integration, adaptability, materiality, selection, data, explainability, performance, human oversight, cyber/ICT and third-party risk.
evidence: Board AI strategy and risk appetite

title: Market-access risk controls
condition: For broker-dealers with market access or providing access through their MPID or otherwise; agent participation does not change the perimeter test.
requirement: Establish, document and maintain risk-management controls and supervisory procedures, including pre-set credit/capital thresholds, erroneous-order controls, restricted securities controls and authorized access restrictions.

title: Personal data, automated decisions and security
condition: Where personal data processing falls within GDPR territorial scope. Article 22 is narrower than all automated processing and requires a decision based solely on automated processing with legal or similarly significant effects, subject to exceptions.
requirement: Apply data protection principles and privacy by design; implement appropriate security; assess lawful basis, transparency, rights, DPIA triggers and Article 22 safeguards where conditions are met.
evidence: Meaningful human intervention records where Article 22 applies
